text:
Bright month cheers for the planning team
A month with farewell routines in mind
Steady care for every companion

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways continues to manage each request with calm attention and practical order. Staff are reminded to check welfare notes carefully, confirm carrier readiness, and keep the traveler informed at every step. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. A welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs.

This month, the desk also encourages close coordination between front-line teams and the ramp staff so that each handoff remains smooth and reassuring. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff. Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel. Clear records, courteous updates, and steady follow-through help every departure begin on the right note.
